description: Na₅FeO₄ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.43 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with ten NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.42 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with three NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.39 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.32 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.35 Å. Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with ten NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with three NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-1.92 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Fe atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Fe pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-55°. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Fe pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-63°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Fe octahedra.
